provider_organization: DiSCo Lazio (Lazio Regional Agency for the Right to Study)
eligible_nationalities: All (students enrolled at universities or AFAM institutions in Lazio, incl. Sapienza)

stipend.notes: Secondary sources give about EUR 2,290-6,571 a year plus two free meals a day; not verified in the call

required_documents.name: Online application in the DiSCo reserved area

preparation_alerts: Non-EU applicants may need a residence permit and foreign income documents; check the call

source_urls.title: DiSCo Lazio: Bando Diritto allo Studio 2026/27 (PDF, 72 pages)

verification_status.verification_notes: The official 72-page call was not read in full. Search excerpts of it show 10 Jun to 22 Jul 2026 for students resident in Italy, and 10 Dec 2026 (and a 10 Feb 2027 date of unclear purpose) for students not resident in Italy. Status left unknown until a human checks which date applies to international students. Amounts from secondary sources.
